result_text:
I fixed the false -100%: the average order value change is now empty when the current month has no orders. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`). I didn't add a test for the zero-orders case.

The change is in `YearOverYearSales.averageOrderValueChangePercent()` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/model/YearOverYearSales.java`. It now returns null when `orderCount == 0`, the same as it already did when last year had no orders. I also updated its Javadoc to match.

The revenue change is untouched, so it still shows -100% in that case. Regions with orders in both years are unaffected, so 20.00 → 40.00 still shows +100%.

I haven't committed anything.
